statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to these symptoms
The diagnosis codes on the claim are I49.9, I34.0, and Z86.73
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
